act_title: The Union Territories (Separation of Judicial and Executive Functions) Act, 1969
title: In sub-section (2) of section 512, for the words “any Magistrate of the first class”, the
text:
80. In sub-section (2) of section 512, for the words “any Magistrate of the first class”, the

words “any judicial Magistrate of the first class” shall be substituted.
